recognize_zh: 抹片中成群的大型細胞，細胞質豐富灰藍色並充滿大量清楚的小空泡，核呈腎形或摺疊、染色質細緻並可見核仁，兼具單核母細胞與組織球的特徵，符合伴組織球分化的 AML。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Numerous uniform, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Fine, lacy chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells
Absence of Auer rods and granules in this field
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a cluster of large cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles, and folded or reniform nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli. Granules and Auer rods are not seen. The cells combine monoblastic/promonocytic nuclear features with histiocyte-like vacuolated cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic and histiocytic differentiation; nonspecific esterase and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD163) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes have mature condensed chromatin without nucleoli and may contain phagocytosed cells, without an accompanying blast population.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles, round nuclei with coarse chromatin and a B-cell phenotype rather than folded nuclei.
Histiocytic sarcoma is a tissue-based neoplasm lacking marrow blast involvement and immature myeloid markers such as CD34/CD117.
